scope: Source review of the 35Z3 rectifier cathode, #28 500 Ω field coil, #29A/#29B 20 µF filter capacitors, #21 filtered B+ branch and the explicitly listed B− return terminals.

findings.label: 35Z3 cathode / first-filter feed
findings.source_note: The native schematic shows the 35Z3 cathode, #28 field-coil input and #29A positive terminal on the first-filter feed. #26:a remains outside this review.

findings.label: Field-coil output / second filter
findings.source_note: The native schematic shows #28 field-coil output, #29B positive terminal and #21 terminal a on the same filtered B+ node.

findings.label: Filter-capacitor B− return
findings.source_note: The native schematic shows these filter-capacitor and resistor terminals on the shared B− return. This does not establish a bond to the metal chassis.

scope_exclusions: AC line switch and both mains paths
any bond between B− and metal chassis
